title: We are the core banking platform
for onchain finance
lead: Your current core banking system holds accounts on ledgers, moves money, enforces the rules, and proves it all to auditors. DFNS is that system, rebuilt for blockchains and token-first operations.

columns.title: Who we are
columns.body: Onchain core banking. Blockchain middleware. The orchestration layer between classic and digital assets, run by people who built the old rails and engineered the new ones.

columns.title: What we do
columns.body: A series of modules to hold, move, control, and prove onchain workflows, from wallets to nodes, transactions, treasury, issuance, policy, governance, workflows, auth, certs, keys, and logs.

columns.title: Why it's different
columns.body: Hundreds of fintechs and institutions, from day-one startups to IBM and Standard Chartered. Banks, brokers, payment services, asset managers, clearing houses, and the public sector.

columns.title: Who runs it
columns.body: Programmable, interoperable, modular, and built for security and scalability. Powered by our code and certified cryptography. Deliberately tech-only so we never compete with you.
